description: A correct, efficient compiler toolchain for JavaScript and TypeScript.

latest_release.name: v0.28.0
latest_release.body:
### Breaking

- `print` and `reanalyze` throw on a hand-built tree with a node where the parser never puts one, such as a `Program` inside an expression, so place nodes where the parser does (#323 by @arshad-yaseen)
- The Zig parser returns `error.OutOfMemory` instead of panicking and `ast.outOfMemory` is gone, so handle the error from `parser.parse` (#323 by @arshad-yaseen)

### Changes

- Code nested too deeply reports `Code is nested too deeply to parse` instead of crashing the process (#323 by @arshad-yaseen)
- Running out of memory throws an error instead of aborting the process (#323 by @arshad-yaseen)
- `print` handles long chains and deep nesting instead of throwing a `RangeError`, and a tree too deep to print reports it in `diagnostics` (#323 by @arshad-yaseen)
- A failed WebAssembly call no longer breaks every parse after it (#323 by @arshad-yaseen)
- TypeScript such as `a<a<a<` no longer takes quadratic time to parse (#323 by @arshad-yaseen)

[![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/yuku?logo=npm&logoColor=212121&label=version&labelColor=ffc44e&color=212121)](https://npmjs.com/package/yuku) [![NPM Downloads](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2Farshad-yaseen%2Fstatic%2Fmain%2Fbadges%2Fyuku-downloads.json&logo=npm&logoColor=212121&labelColor=ffc44e&color=212121)](https://npmtrends.com/yuku-analyzer-vs-yuku-codegen-vs-yuku-parser) [![sponsor](https://img.shields.io/badge/sponsor-EA4AAA?logo=githubsponsors&labelColor=FAFAFA)](https://github.com/sponsors/arshad-yaseen) Yuku is a high-performance JavaScript/TypeScript compiler toolchain written in Zig. [Try it in the playground →](https://playground.yuku.fyi)
## JavaScript ```bash npm install yuku ``` One import parses, analyzes, walks, builds, and prints JavaScript and TypeScript, in Node.js, Bun, Deno, browsers, and edge runtimes. See the [JavaScript guide](https://yuku.fyi/javascript/). ## Zig ```bash zig fetch --save git+https://github.com/yuku-toolchain/yuku.git ``` The parser, AST, semantic analysis, traversal, and codegen are documented at [yuku.fyi](https://yuku.fyi). ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) to set up, test, and try a change. Report vulnerabilities privately, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) describes. ## License Yuku is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
